content:
sam: Hey arch team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8372 is ready but blocked on the RFC. Can someone bless the design before we schedule canary / flip traffic? RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/8372
anita: @sam can you paste the short SLO delta? need to see latency and error impact.
matt: quick heads-up — load tests on staging showed ~1.8x tail latency for long-sequence requests when batching is enabled. I added full numbers and graphs to the PR comments.
sam: thanks @matt. SLO delta summary: +15ms p95, +40ms p99 on the 99th-percentile long-seq path; error rate unchanged. I put a short summary in the RFC under "runtime impact" and linked the perf artifacts.
kai: I can take a pass — will review the RFC and PR in the next hour. if i'm +1 i'll leave an arch note and a short mitigation checklist.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary window 2025-03-25T10:00:00Z - 2025-03-25T11:00:00Z, hold set until arch approval is posted.
anita: ok, @kai once you ACK we'll pick the 1-hour canary and define rollback steps (route to fallback model + reduce batch size). also want confirmation that KV cache uses per-tenant prefixes so no cross-tenant leakage.
kai: acked with comments — main ask: call out cache isolation and fallback routing in the RFC. added inline suggestion to the "safety considerations" section.
sam: will update the RFC and PR description with a one-line cache-isolation note and the rollback plan. pinging back here when done. hoping to merge today if no further concerns. :thumbsup:
